title_sq: Penthouse panoramik 565 m2 ne Mbikalimin e Komunes se Parisit
description_sq:
Shitet Penthouse ne zonen e mbikalimit te Komunes se Parisit me siperfaqe 565m2.
Ndodhur ne katin e 9 te nje ndertese te re, ky penthouse organizohet ne 3 dhoma gjumi, 3 tualete, depo, verande qe rrethon te gjithe ambientet duke ofruar dalje nga cdo dhome.
Me akses te vecante per katin e 9, ofron siguri maksimale dhe qetesi.
Ofrohet teresisht i mobiluar ne menyre bashkekohore e me teknologji te avancuar.
I pershtatshem edhe per investim pasi mund te ndahet ne apartamente.
Per me teper informacion, na kontaktoni!
title_en: Panoramic penthouse 565 m2 in the Paris Commune Overpass
description_en: Penthouse for sale in the overpass area of ​​the Municipality of Paris with a surface area of ​​565m2. Located on the 9th floor of a new building, this penthouse is organized in 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, storage room, veranda that surrounds all the premises, offering exit from each room. With special access to the 9th floor, it offers maximum security and peace. It is offered fully furnished in a contemporary way and with advanced technology. Also suitable for investment as it can be divided into apartments. For more information, contact us!
